pageDescription: Retaining of form inputs in full page forms, drawers, modals

defaultBehaviour.title: Default behaviour
items: When filling form fields and attempting to leave page (i.e. browser back), a "Discard changes" modal will be displayed to either continue editing or discard their changes.
Previously entered data is not recoverable once discarded.
Save as draft/Autosave (based on user data change and accepted) feature would only be designed based on requirement

example.alt: Discard changes confirmation modal with Continue editing and Discard changes actions
